question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Serve
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Serve"** means to perform duties or services for another person or an organization. (सेवा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He has **served** the company for over 30 years.
 
 
 
• **"Attend"** means to be present at an event, meeting, or function, or to look after someone. (उपस्थित होना)
 
 
• **Example:** She will **attend **the conference next week.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carrousel** (दुमंजिला गोल चक्कर): A merry-go-round or a rotating machine or device.

 
 
• **Example:** The children enjoyed riding the carrousel at the amusement park.
 
 
 
• **Carrier** (वाहक): A person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.
 
 
• **Example:** The courier company is a reliable carrier for your parcels.
 
 
 
• **Abandon** (त्यागना): To give up completely or to leave without intending to return.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to abandon the old house and move to a new one.
